messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered - increased 500s and generation queue backlog in eu-west-1. Alert rule: gen_queue_depth > 300 for 2m :rotating_light:
priya (oncall): looking now. taking lead. switching pager to me :hand:
priya (oncall): quick status: queues elevated, partial throttling to low-tier tenants. no full outage yet.
sam (eng-sre): ping me if you want me in. I can check autoscaler and latest deploys.
maria (prod-ops): noted — starting statuspage draft. will need customer impact bullets and ETA estimate from eng.
csm-jordan: heads-up — a handful of customers reported higher response times, not errors yet. they asked for ETA.
priya (oncall): root cause suspicious: spike of long-context requests from one client shard + autoscaler not scaling fast enough. investigating logs now.
sam (eng-sre): saw a burst of requests with seq_len ~ 32k. those amplify kv cache pressure. I can spin an emergency scale to add 2 nodes if we want.
maria (prod-ops): draft initial status update below — pls review. keep short.
maria (prod-ops): ```
We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1 affecting some requests. Users may experience slower responses or timeouts. Our on-call team is actively mitigating and we will post updates every 20 minutes. No evidence of data loss.```
priya (oncall): edit: add affected scope line.
maria (prod-ops): updated draft: ```
Initial: We are investigating increased generation latency and elevated error rates for some requests served from eu-west-1 (affecting a subset of customers and lower-priority requests). On-call is mitigating; we will post updates every 20 minutes. No data loss expected.```
csm-jordan: can we add a note to encourage customers to retry and mention dedicated capacity not impacted?
sam (eng-sre): yes add: retry with reduced context length if possible; dedicated and private deployments not impacted.
maria (prod-ops): final initial draft ready: ```
Initial notice (eu-west-1): We are investigating increased generation latency and elevated error rates for a subset of requests in eu-west-1. Customers may see slower responses or occasional timeouts. On-call is actively mitigating — mitigation work includes adding capacity and throttling large-context requests. Dedicated and private deployments are not impacted. We will provide updates every 20 minutes.```
priya (oncall): :eyes: looks fine. sam, go ahead with emergency scale when ready. I'll continue digging into request patterns.
sam (eng-sre): scaling now — `rcli scale cluster eu-west-1 gen-pool +2` — ETA ~3m.
ops-bot: Status page draft queued for approval: "eu-west generation latency". Approvals needed: eng-sre, oncall.
priya (oncall): approved. sam approved. maria please publish initial.
maria (prod-ops): publishing now...
ops-bot: Status page update published (initial) at 5200000120. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5210 :white_check_mark:
csm-jordan: thanks — I'll ping impacted customers with the short note and link.
priya (oncall): scaling complete. queue depth down ~40% and 500s dropping. continuing monitoring.
sam (eng-sre): quick mitigation note: dropped large-context burst via temporary rate-limit for token_length>16k for shared tier; leaving a 10% throttle for 15m.
maria (prod-ops): preparing 20m update. draft below.
maria (prod-ops): ```
Update (20m): We added capacity and implemented a temporary throttle for very large requests. Queue depth and error rates have decreased. Some customers may still experience intermittent latency. We continue to monitor; next update in 20 minutes.```
priya (oncall): looks accurate. publish.
ops-bot: Status page update published (20m) at 5200000240. :white_check_mark:
csm-jordan: relaying update to impacted customers now; adding recommendation to reduce context length if they can.
priya (oncall): metrics look stable but tail latency still slightly elevated. recommending keep throttles for another 10m.
sam (eng-sre): agree. leaving scale and throttle for 10m, then reassess.
maria (prod-ops): final resolve draft below once cleared.
maria (prod-ops): ```
Resolved: The increased generation latency in eu-west-1 has been mitigated. We added capacity and applied a temporary throttle to very large-context requests; queue depth and error rates have returned to normal. We will remove the temporary throttle once stability is verified. We will follow up with a post-incident summary. If you continue to see issues, contact support.```
priya (oncall): resolved check: 15m of stable metrics, 500s at baseline. I confirm resolved.
ops-bot: Status page update published (resolved) at 5200000365. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/5210/resolved :white_check_mark:
priya (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll open the post-incident doc and add timeline + mitigation details.
sam (eng-sre): will add logs and the autoscaler tweak we applied.
csm-jordan: I'll follow up with the customers we reached out to and share the post-incident link. :thumbsup:
